.gamut-fit-screen.status: In Chrome 155, WebKit 26.4 and Firefox 158 a canvas paints `oklch(0.7 0.4 30)` as 255 0 0.

--gamut-method.status: No draft defines a syntax for it.

.gamut-screen-edge.status: No draft defines a syntax for it.

.gamut-palette-step.status: No draft defines a syntax for it. #11533 asks for color math over more than one color, with tints from an accent and its lightest tint as one example; this part takes one seed's HCT hue and chroma and gives Material 3's tonal palette.

.gamut-fit-gradient.status: No draft defines a syntax for it. #9449 asks for mapping in place of clipping, and `linear-gradient(in oklch, …)` clips the colors between its stops; #1332, resolved 2021-09-01, puts an easing function between two stops (`black, ease-in-out, transparent`), in no draft yet.

.gamut-readable-text.status: Chrome 155, WebKit 26.4 and Firefox 158 ship `contrast-color()` with black or white only. #5153 asks to adjust a given text color's lightness to a ratio, #7360 to pick from a range of colors and #11619's third case to tweak a color until the contrast is good enough. This part takes a color toward white, black or another color in linear sRGB, not along OkLCh lightness. The WG deferred #5153 and #7360.

.gamut-contrast-color.status: Chrome 155, WebKit 26.4 and Firefox 158 don't ship it. They ship CSS Color 5's `contrast-color()`, black or white only.

.gamut-color-layers.status: Chrome 155, WebKit 26.4 and Firefox 158 don't ship it.

.gamut-color-interpolate.status: Chrome 155, WebKit 26.4 and Firefox 158 don't ship it. css-values-5 §7.5 specifies it; #6694 asked for color ramps and #10034 (color-scale(), retracted by its author) for scales.

.gamut-okhsl.status: No draft defines a syntax for it.

.gamut-okhsl-from.status: No draft defines a syntax for it.

.gamut-okhsv.status: No draft defines a syntax for it.

.gamut-color-mix.status: Firefox 158 ships it; Chrome 155 and WebKit 26.4 don't.

.gamut-mix-paint.status: Chrome 155, WebKit 26.4 and Firefox 158 don't ship it. The issue names spectral.js and Mixbox; the part follows spectral.js 3.0.0. The draft's editor answered that Kubelka-Munk is one pigment model of many.

.gamut-alpha.status: Chrome 155 and Firefox 158 ship it; WebKit 26.4 doesn't. Both ask how its result serializes, which the part leaves to the browser.

.gamut-light-dark.status: No draft defines a syntax for it. #13836 asks for `light-dark()` to resolve where a color is used; the part keeps a token as its two colors and resolves it there.

.gamut-color-equal.status: No draft defines a syntax for it. CSS Color 4 §12 defines the comparison for `style()` queries and transitions; the part gives it as a number.

.gamut-device-cmyk.status: Chrome 155, WebKit 26.4 and Firefox 158 don't ship it. CSS Color 5 specifies it (§6); #13934 asks for more, interpolating it in ink amounts.

.gamut-rec2100-pq.status: Chrome 155, WebKit 26.4 and Firefox 158 don't ship it.

.gamut-jzazbz.status: Chrome 155, WebKit 26.4 and Firefox 158 don't ship it.

.gamut-hdr-color.status: Chrome 155, WebKit 26.4 and Firefox 158 don't ship it.

.gamut-color-extract.status: No draft defines a syntax for it.
